trust.title: A clearer picture of the product
trust.description: We separate product facts, user experience, and research so you can understand what is known and what still needs verification.
trust.statementTitle: Evidence should match the product you use.
trust.statementBody: Studies of oral berberine do not prove the same absorption or outcomes for a topical patch. Finished-product studies would be needed for product-specific claims.
trust.oneBody: The 60-count pack and patch format are shown in the captured listing; current label details should be checked before use.
trust.twoBody: Oral, preclinical transdermal, and finished-product evidence are different categories and should not be treated as interchangeable.
trust.threeBody: Skin sensitivity, medications, pregnancy, and individual health circumstances can matter. Ask a clinician when appropriate.
